kjv: to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them
mine: to those under the law I became as one under the law (though not being myself under the law)
note: TR lacks "me on autos hypo nomon", present in P46, Sinaiticus, A, B, C, D, F, G; the omission (by homoeoteleuton) loses Paul's own disclaimer.

kjv: lest that by any means … I myself should be a castaway
mine: lest … I myself should be disqualified
note: adokimos is the athletic term "disqualified" (continuing the race image of 9:24–26); "castaway" suggests shipwreck or reprobation.
